main.description: Take in processed signals from koke/hakkou into ki vascular input (xylem). Analogous to root absorption — raw signals enter the vascular system for upward transport toward synthesis.

inputKind.description: Kind of input: fixation | ferment | transfer

content.description: Raw content or reference to absorb
